comparison.objective: Load a brush with pollen and hand-pollinate two female flowers.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine brush pickup and millimeter-scale contact strokes in the correct sequence.
comparison.success_condition: Each female receives a qualifying stroke only after pollen is acquired from a male flower.
comparison.reason: Tests delicate tool-tip trajectories and ordering, not fastener torque, rotary locking or physical cycle commissioning. No separate spec versions were present; the body supplied the rubric.
